name: print-social-playful-supplement-infographic-set
title: Kids supplement listing images in cosmic green and indigo
whatItIs: A long sheet of e-commerce listing images for a children's brain-support gummy. Panels alternate emerald green and indigo, with cartoon planets, stars and brain icons, callouts for ingredients, lifestyle photos and review-style tiles, plus three variants for teen, women's and multi products.
whatItMeans: Fun yet credible: cartoon space motifs signal kid-friendly, while structured callouts and ratings keep it trustworthy for parents.
techniques: Build a small cast of illustrated mascots (planets, stars) that recur across every panel.
Alternate two deep background colours to divide message blocks rhythmically.
Label each ingredient with an icon plus benefit tag to answer questions visually.
Mix lifestyle photography with product shots and social-proof tiles in one grid.
Reuse the layout with a colour swap for each product variant.

vocabulary.definition: An image slot in an e-commerce product page.
A label with a leader pointing out a feature.
Recolouring one layout for a product line.
